notes.title: Patch v0.5.993 and Event news!
notes.content:
Hi Forgeborn!   
Got some updates here for you!  

-Fixed issue with the ordering of triggers 
-Fix on a few Forge Cores in campaign mode
-Undoing a SolBind Creature no longer has it stuck in your hand 
-Forgeborn abilities can now be seen in the game log 
-Added small pop up for when the opponent passes priority to you due to an effect like Reveler. 
-Solve for some of the client crashes. Please continue to submit reports when you have these crashes, every bit of info helps!  

Here are some of the things in the background we are working on: 

-Tallying up Season 1 Points and finish setting up a way to distribute prizing 

-Working on Season 2 

-Mobile app development  

We also have an event coming up soon! 

September 27th - Storyline Event - The Tempys Trials! 

The Tempys are known for their ability to brave the elements to become more powerful warriors. Every once in awhile they challenge the other factions of Solis to compete against one another in these trials. Being the first to complete certain challenges will bring pride and glory to their faction.   Speed, skill, and adaptability are needed for this event as each team races to complete certain challenges within the digital app! More details will be shown at the event!  The event will at most take 2 hours. Registration starts at 4:30pm ET/1:30pm PT with event starting at 5pm ET/2pm ET.  

In addition to signing up for this event you must also fill out this form to see what team you will be put into, the sooner you submit the more likely you are to get your top choice: https://forms.gle/V2JZUYpZjGSEfWr38 

Event Page: https://events.solforgefusion.com/event/XLEQEAH090

notes.title: Patch v0.5.923 Updates
notes.content:
Hi Forgeborn!

Been a little bit since our last update, have been working on a lot of different things in the background. Here are some bug fixes and updates!



-Fixed Campaign Cores for Tooth and Claw

-Fixed Tool Tip for PvE Cards

-When opening a deck with a betrayer it will now pop up instead of only showing 9 cards in the deck

notes.title: End of Season 1 Patch v0.5.901
notes.content:
Hi all! Season 1 has ended! We are adding up all the points and making sure people aren't missing any due to bugs. We will have tallied up scores and post the leaderboard within a couple weeks!

-Removed the Season Awards section and replaced it with Leaderboards.

-Updates to the tutorial.

-New visual when opening up faction decks.

-Removed opponent’s Banish and Discard piles. These can be turned back on in the setting in a match.

-Fixed random to select 2 random faction decks and not a random fused deck.

-Fixed bug that would allow you to different nodes in the campaign.

notes.title: Friend Referrals and Visual Updates
notes.content:
Friend Referrals

We've added a new way to earn Gold and Seasonal Achivement Points. Players now have a unique referral code that can be given to new players to enter when creating an account. This links the two accounts, and when the new player earns at least 50,000 XP or purchases our Premium Mastery Track, both players will earn rewards. The new player will earn 2,500 Gold, and the referring player player will earn 500 Gold and 500 Seasonal Achievement Points for their first 10 referrals, and 1000 Gold and 1000 Seasonal Achievement Points for each referral thereafter. View the "Friends" menu in-game to track your referred friends, claim rewards, and get more information.

Trigger Visual Updates

We are continuing to update and improved SolForge Fusion visuals game gameplay. We heard your feedback about our last visual update and have reduced the amount of screen shaking when playing cards. As a next step in improving the game, we've overhauled the way that triggers appear during gameplay. Triggers will now appear above the creature or player that created them. Triggers from destroyed creatures will now appear from the banish pile. Once you'fve selected a trigger to resolve, all other triggers should disappear so that you can view the full board for the selected trigger. We believe this will help clarify where triggers are originating and better communicate what's happening during gameplay.

Bug Fixes

 Rumblespark Energy transforming into Embodiment on Spirit Golem Conclave should now trigger the 
 attack buff.
 Pipwick Level 3 now steals Electronet and gives the appropriate targets.
 Creature being reanimated after being webbed should no longer have the webbed and defender icon.
 Updated new hand animations, reduced the shake of playing cards.
 Changed the red lettered Done on turn button to be white lettered Skip.
 Fixed betrayer icons that weren’t showing properly on some cards.
 Fixed an issue allowing forgeborn to be switched mid campaign.
 Attempted a fix for cards disappearing when action is undone.
 Attempted fix for Badges window covering up the game timer in multiplayer.

notes.title: Patch v.0.5.501
notes.content:
Features
We have started work on improving visuals and making the play experience more engaging and easier to follow. Our first change is improving the visuals of the cards in your hand as well as playing cards. More improvements are coming soon.

We have added a random name button in fuse decks.

Bugfixes - Game

Abilities that open the opponent’s banish/discard piles will now do so correctly instead of opening the player’s pile. (I.e. Cercee’s Graverobbery)
Abilities that require you to select an opponent’s lane will now highlight the opponent’s lanes rather than your own. (Korok Whirlwind, Entrapment)
Cards which let you pick an exalt in play will now highlight their lane. (I.e. Corpus Cliffs)
Runescarred Pit and Thundercrash Field now have highlights over the currently selected lane when minions are being placed.
Campaign upgrades that include giving creatures different creature types should now stack correctly with upgrades that give keywords to creature types.
Palladium Pulsemage activate can no longer destroy Chrogias
Cultist Taskmaster deploy now has opposing dragons strike only the creature opposing them and not all opposing creature
Poltergeist creatures at level 2 and 3 have corrected damage and healing effects
Creatures with state-like abilities now have the three line icon on creature squares while on the battlefield (ex: Piercing creatures)
Insidious Rager (set 4) is now destroyed when the player only loses armor and not health.

Bugfixes - Other

Bug report window should no longer be able to pop up while naming a fused deck
Finalizing fuse deck button is now interactable if you enter the fuse menu with a name pre-selected
Addressed a soft lock in the campaign tutorial where you can’t proceed without potions
Arrows no longer show up in magnify screen for cards which do not have all 3 levels (i.e. Minions, Solbinds)
Fixed an issue of the player not receiving random deck quest credit when the opponent times out.

Known Issues

If you play a creature card and undo, keywords on that creature are visually disappearing.

notes.content:

 Pre-combat damage reducing a players’ health to zero is now stopping combat.
 Betrayer cards should no longer change to the original version of the card when it is sent to the Banish pile.

 Endless Hunt will now trigger on Solbind creatures like Honor Guard
 Briguard Carrier effect is now optional and can be canceled

For questions and support visit our discord!

notes.title: V0.5.327 Shadows of Solis Release Patch Notes
notes.content:
Shadows over Solis is here!

Darkness spreads across Solis as powerful forces clash for control of its future. A long-buried power has awakened, unleashing new threats and forcing heroes and villains alike to take their stand. Across the land, new Forgeborn rise, each shaping the destiny of their factions in ways never seen before.

As alliances shift and rivalries ignite, the balance of power is more fragile than ever. The fate of Solis is unwritten—will its defenders stand together against the growing darkness, or will division lead to its downfall? Shadows loom, and the next chapter of Solis is yours to forge.

Features

 Set 4 booster packs and single faction decks are now available in the shop.
 Set 4 phantom decks are also available to purchase for 25 Embers but will last for 2 weeks.
 New quests have been added to include the new forgeborn - Toxys Mori, Tundra, Tyran
Blighted Sunder and Blighted Cercee will contribute to the original Sunder and Cercee quests.
 New quests have been added to include playing with more creature types - Metaminds, Darkforge Creatures
 New quests have been added to include new mechanics - Blast, Augments

Bugfixes

 Blightmane Dragon level 2 adjacent blast now deals the full 5 damage.
 Fungal Curse level 2 now destroys all augments on an enemy creature.
 Fungal Curse level 3 now destroys all augments on all enemy creatures.
 Duplicitous creatures can be targeted from destroying Blackcherry Dread.
 Dragging and releasing a spell shouldn't undo if you have no actions available.

notes.title: New Seasonal Rewards and New Deck Filter
notes.content:
Community Seasonal Achievements Rewards
You can gain Achievement Points for interacting with the community! From running tournaments to streaming the game, you can now submit these events and get more points for season.
You can submit your contributions here: Achievement Points Content Creation/Event Organization
We will be updating these community achievements and awarding points to players 30 days before the end of the season as well as at the end of the season.

Collection Based Achievements
We have added new achievements based on collecting different faction decks as well as collecting high rarity decks. These achievements will be able to update and award points immediately.

Improved Deck Filter
We have improved the deck filter “search” function! You can now search for decks by card name, creature type, and some other categories (solbind, exalt, betrayer, phantom, certain card attributes like stealth, minion, free, etc.). You can search for a deck with multiple cards by separating each item with a comma.

Updated the shop and added a new Double Booster Pack deal for Whitefang Pass.

Minor updates added to the Game Log.

Bugfixes
 Fixed an issue where undoing in an online game would reset the turn timer.
 Fixed some spells that pass control to your opponent should now warn you before passing.
 Fixed an issue where using the “favorites” filter failed if you haven’t opened the filter yet.
 When you are viewing your deck while on the campaign map the map zooms when you scroll to view your cards.
 Harbinger Staff should no longer be able to target the original creature that was delt damage.
 Blighted Oros Entropic Aura - should now accurately calculate the attack of your creatures attack when seeing which of the enemy creatures you can destroy.
 Cercee Graverobbery - Replacing a stolen creature now puts that creature in the enemy players banish pile.
 Work done on the progress bar on the seasonal reward tracker not reaching claimable rewards.

notes.title: Welcome to Season One!
notes.content:
We’re introducing a new seasonal progression system, allowing players to earn achievement points, claim rewards, and compete against their fellow Forgeborn in both daily and overall leaderboards!

For this initial release, players will begin earning points for gameplay and daily activities. In the very near future, we’ll be releasing additional achievements for growing your collection and engaging with the SolForge Fusion community. Everything you do matters!

Rise through the ranks in our daily leaderboards! Each day we will be awarding points to the top 10 players for: 
 XP earned in the Reclusa Campaign
 XP earned in the Scorchwyrm Campaign
 XP earned in PvP games
 PvP Wins
As you earn points, you’ll unlock rewards on the Seasonal Reward Track, including things like: 
 Gold
 Embers
 Decks (Phantom/Normal)
 Potions
 Emotes

We have also included new Steam achievements tied to these seasonal progress. We're planning even bigger rewards for all participants at the end of the season, with more information coming soon.

For more information on how to earn points and claim your rewards, click here.

New Features
 Seasonal achievements and rewards track
 Report player button appears in PVP games
Bugfixes
 Cercee Graverobbery (set 3) - Stolen shamblers/shambling creatures that are destroyed will trigger for the player who stole the creature and not the original owner.
 Blighted Ironbeard Ruthless Advance (Set 3)  should now deal excess damage to the enemy player.
 Uprising (Set 3) Creatures should not be losing the correct amount of attack when they are reducing attack
 Central Conductor (Set 3) is now gaining energy counters when transforming so Mass Link can be used.
 Icefrost Wyvern now has Defender.
 Ruthless Army now has Defender.
 Betrayer Corpse Hosts now plays betrayer Necrolab and Necrotower.
 We are currently aware and working on fixing Blighted Oros.

notes.title: Holiday Phantom Queue is Open!
notes.content:
For the holidays we are opening our phantom event again!
 
Starting now until Jan 1st you will be able to play in our limited queue! Compete against other players with a fused deck made of 2 phantom decks. Win 5 games to solbind your deck and make it permanent. Lose 3 games, and you're out. If you get three losses you will still gain rewards based on the number of wins you made with the deck:

 1 Win: 200 Gold
 2 Wins: 400 Gold
 3 Wins: 600 Gold
 4 Wins: 800 Gold
 5 Wins: 800 Gold and Phantom Decks Solbound

In the shop you can find 2 free event tickets and an event bundle that comes with a phantom booster and event ticket.

Thank you for all your support and have a wonderful new year!



Bug Fixes:

 Fixed the upright numbers to be actually upright.
 Fixed Stone Skin to be able to be played on a creature when there are no enemy creatures.
 Fixed a Duplication Dome bug where it was giving the Warrior buff to itself and not other Warriors. We are still looking at other cases of this Dome improperly targeting some deploys.

notes.title: Phantom Queue through this Weekend
notes.content:
Today marks the beta launch of a brand-new type of online event using Phantom Decks in our SolForge Fusion app, available on Steam.

Here's how it works:

Free Entry: Pick up two free event tickets in our in-game shop. Each ticket allows you to join the event queue for up to three games.

Win Rewards: Earn Gold to use in the shop for every win along the way. Achieve three consecutive wins and you’ll earn the ability to Solbind phantom decks, making each deck a permanent part of your collection!

The event will run all weekend long, so feel free to jump in, explore, and give it a real stress test! Since this is a new format, expect some quirks or bugs, and please let us know your thoughts to help shape this feature's future.

Don't forget to pick up your 4 free phantom decks this month in the shop as well.


 Bug Fixes/Updates 

 Buying embers have been moved to the top of the screen.
 Removed first/last name from account creation.
 Player’s random deck status medal should now show properly in pvp.
 Items with account limit will now update immediately after purchase.
 Put in a fix to stop the news screen from being stuck on the screen.
 V Formation should now be posted as a global power.
 Clan War Drums should be posted as a global power.
 Necromantic Research should be posted as a global power.
 Mad Mini Minion Machine will now trigger creatures like Steeleye Researcher.
 Made changes to text editing to have preview cards show up when looking at forge cores, please send a bug report for any preview card highlight not showing up.
 Fix to allow to claim free item even if steam overlay disabled.
 When you have multiple of the same quest, claiming one will not delete all copies.
 Shop now displays error messages on failed purchases.

notes.title: Scorchwyrm has Arrived
notes.content:
The new campaign is now available for premium mastery owners.

 64 new encounters to test your might as you travel to defeat the Elder Scrochwyrm.
 41 new deck enhancements to discover.
 8 new Blighted encounters! These will appear randomly when playing in the Scorchwrm campaign and are designed to add an extra level of challenge. Defeating them will net you an extra enhancement for your deck, as well as some bonus XP.

 Updates for all campaigns 

Along with our new campaign, we have updated all campaigns with new art frames for each encounter.
Encounter modifiers have been visually updated to more easily tell if modifiers will affect you, the boss or both.
We have added tool tips so you can now view cards referenced in the encounter modifiers.

New Premium Currency - Embers 

We’ve added a new premium currency to the game–Embers–which can now be used to purchase in-game items from the store. Save on purchases by buying Embers in bulk at a discounted price!

Additional Updates

 News pops up when there are new articles
 Solbind potions can now be found in the mystery chests on the Mastery Track.
 New quests have been added that involve using Random decks.
 When you are using a random deck, you get a “Random” medal added to your medal dashboard while in game.
 Added a toggle to game settings to disable bots in queue.
 We have done a first round of formatting for cards specifically found in the campaign. These cards should now have keywords bolded. We are aware of Exalted cards having symbols instead of the em-dash.

Storyline Event
Join us in celebrating the launch of the campaign by participating in our week-long online storyline event to decide the fate of the Scorchwyrm. From October 22nd through the 28th all XP earned while playing in the Scorchwyrm campaign will earn points for your Forgeborn's faction. We will post daily leaderboards in our Discord (https://discord.gg/YTpX3KVFbe ) showing which faction is currently ahead in the event!

Prizes!

Top 10 XP earners each day will earn a Last Winter deck!
Each person who earns 50k XP over the course of the week will earn a Last Winter booster!
Each player who earns 50k XP in the winning faction at the end of the event will get to help decide the fate of the Scorchwyrm!
The leader of each faction at the end of the week will get deck lore attached to their favorite deck they used in the event!

Learn about the story of the event here: https://solforgefusion.com/post/scorchwyrm-storyline-event--intro

notes.title: Phantom no More!
notes.content:
Solbind Potions
We have added a new potion to the shop! You can now purchase Solbind potions to convert your phantom decks into digital decks! In your collection view a phantom deck and select the potion icon to use your Soldbind potion.

 Medals & Steam Achievements 
We have added steam achievements to the game! Along with these achievements you will be rewarded with medals when you complete these achievements. In the cosmetics menu you can now add medals to your banner on the matchmaking screen as well as these medals will now show up during online matches. Medals will also be given out as exclusive rewards not just for achievements. We will be rewarding Kickstarter backers their exclusive medals soon.

 Unlockable Campaign Encounters Updates 
All unlockable encounters have been updated to have changed decks and will no longer have different boss powers each time you fight them. We have made these changes as having new powers for each encounter made it hard to be able to strategize how to face them.

 Bug Fixes 

 Fraud’s Experiments should now be loading properly.
 Elementalist Knight is now being granted slay abilities from other cards and being able to be targeted by other effects.

notes.title: New Shop Experience and Quest Changes
notes.content:
Updated Shop 
We've made a number of revisions to our shop interface in a continuing effort to improve the experience for our users. Items have been grouped more appropriately for ease of purchase and players will now receive notifications when new shop items are available.

 Quests 
We have updated our quest system from your feedback. Players will now gain one quest every 4 hours and will have the ability to delete unwanted quests.

 When a creature has had its keywords removed, they now can gain those keywords again in the same turn.
 Cypien Experimentation no longer plays a gizmo when played normally.
 Conscript the Dead no longer gives an enemy creature a debuff if none of your creatures are destroyed.

notes.title: Play SolForge Fusion on Mac Today for Free!
notes.content:
SolForge Fusion is now Free-to-Play on Steam!

Today will be your first chance to start your SolForge Fusion adventure without spending a dime because the game is now free-to-play. Our vision for SolForge Fusion has always been to bring the game to as many players as possible. By making this change, we are removing barriers to entry and broadening the community for the good of all.

For our current players, we have some fantastic rewards waiting just for you as a token of appreciation for supporting the game.

Here’s what awaits new players:

Limitless Unique Decks: Explore and master countless deck combinations with algorithmically generated campaigns tailored to your style.

Daily Quests & Upgrades: Take on daily challenges, earn rewards, and enhance your decks with consumable potions and upgrades.

Cross-Compatibility: All physical decks can be scanned into your online account, allowing you to enjoy seamless gameplay across both digital and physical formats.

Available on PC & Mac: Play anytime, anywhere on your preferred platform.

Here are the Gifts and Bonuses for current players:

Current owners of SolForge Fusion will receive a free booster pack (includes 4 Faction Decks), and complimentary access to the all-new Premium Mastery Track.

The Premium Mastery Track will be unlocked for existing players but will be a paid feature for new free-to-play users. Additionally, all players who purchased the game before our transition to free-to-play will receive a free Digital Booster Pack containing four free decks. We’ll announce how current players will claim those decks soon.

This is the perfect time to expand your collection, refine your strategies, and engage with the SolForge Fusion community. Join players from around the world and experience the full depth of SolForge Fusion, which is now more accessible than ever.

notes.title: Gain Gold through Quests!
notes.content:
Quests 
We are proud to unveil our brand new Quest system. Quests provide challenges you can complete while playing games to earn more Gold, which you can redeem in the Shop for Phantom Decks, potions, and other purchases. You will have a selection of six quests to complete each day. Once a day, if you have less than six quests, you will be assigned new quests until you have six available.

 We are going free to play! 
On Thursday, August 15th, we will be moving to a free-to-play model. Our vision for SolForge Fusion has always been to bring the game to as many players as possible. In making this change, we are removing barriers to entry and broadening the community for the good of all. For those that already purchased the game, you will be receiving even more rewards with details to follow shortly!

 Mastery Track Changes 
With the change to free-to-play, we are making some changes to the Mastery Track. New players joining the game for free will note that certain rewards on the Mastery Track are locked. These are tied to our premium Mastery Track offering. In order to unlock these rewards, players will need to visit the Shop and upgrade their Mastery Track to premium. All players who have already purchased the game and supported us on this journey will automatically have their accounts upgraded to the premium Mastery Track and should notice no change in their progress and rewards.

 Bug Fixes 

 Night Apotheosis will now no longer transform when destroyed while printed abilities are removed.
 Uterra Charger does not Battle after it is destroyed even if it has a trigger to resolve.
 Rex creatures’ Battle triggers no longer resolve if the creature is destroyed.
 Bartok buff no longer affects every Zombie made from Nix Nekyia’s Army of the Damned Forgeborn power.
 Omnomnom no longer makes a zombie when played and no enemy creatures are selected. (Ex: enemy player board is empty and the spell is played.)
 Rimehorn Charger now triggers if a creature was destroyed in the same turn.
 Yeti Warcaller is no longer able to activate after an Exalt is moved.
 Regia the Ironlady’s Mech Mark I and II Exalts now play in the lane where Regia was destroyed.

 AI Enhancements 

 AI should not replace minions when playing multiple minions at one time.
 AI should no longer replace Exalts on its board.
 AI should now value playing Bartok on the first action correctly.
 AI should now value playing Oxidon Rager adjacent to a creature correctly.
 AI should now value playing Isolate when there is an enemy creature with no adjacent creatures correctly.

notes.title: Card Bug Fixes

Bug Fixes

 Slay keyword now should not trigger from destroying your own creatures.
 Elementalist Knights exalted ability triggers correctly.

 Effects like Necrotic creatures that let you play up to one creature when it is destroyed will let you say no and not play the creature.

notes.title: Potions and Gold!
notes.content:
Potions!

Potions are a new type of consumable you can use during a campaign run. They will give you a one-time bonus for the next encounter you face. Currently, you can receive the following potions:


 Health Potion: You start your next encounter with +25 Health.
 Strength Potion: All creatures in your deck have +3 Attack for the next encounter.
 Speed Potion: All creatures in your deck have Aggressive for the next encounter.


Potions can be earned through the Player XP Rewards Track, or be purchased either in the Store or during a campaign run. Additional potions may be added over time.

In-game currency - Gold!

Gold can now be earned through the rewards on the Player XP Rewards Track and can be used either to purchase additional potions or new Phantom Decks from the Store. You can also purchase additional potions directly from your campaign.

Potions will cost players 300 gold, while a new Phantom Deck will cost 500 gold.

Players will see their total gold on the game’s main screen, within the Player XP Rewards Track, and within the Store.

Additional ways to earn gold will be coming soon!

notes.title: Quality of Life Fixes, Matchmaking changes
notes.content:
Gameplay 

 Matchmaking will attempt to match you to players closer to your level. We have now implemented a matchmaking system to track your wins with specific decks and queues you closer to players with similar deck elo.
 Cannot undo after Crux Cobalt’s Mind Over Matter or Determined Choice (These reveal new information to the player).
 Reduced XP thresholds for first 2 decks on Player XP Track to 500xp and 5000xp.
 New user flow updates - New users can access the settings when they first open the game and after the tutorial when the user presses play they will be put into the campaign
 We have removed the first encounter's passive abilities in the campaign. These are all the forgeborn encounters. We want these first encounters to be an easy start to the campaign and at this moment the average win rate between these encounters is 71%. We are looking for this to be closer to 90%. So as a first change we are just removing these extra abilities and making them closer to a regular game of SolForge Fusion.
 New temp upgrades:
 Blazing Sol Stone: When you play a creature, if you have the Forge, it gets +A equal to the current cycle. Otherwise, it gets +H equal to the current cycle.
 Umbral Sol Stone: When you play a spell, if you have the Forge, deal 2 damage to the enemy player. Otherwise, you gain +2H.
 Blasted Battlefield: At the start of combat, if you have no empty lanes, your creatures get +3A.
 Digitization Module: At the start of combat, give one of your creatures +3A. If it is your only creature in play, give it +3H.
 Uttera Charger's Horn: At the start of combat, one of your creatures Battles an enemy creature.

UI

 Collection, Deck Select, and Fuse Decks load in pages rather than showing all decks at once. (Should make collection management for large collections less laggy)
 Added digital/physical deck filter toggles, updated filter tooltip for the former “Digital” to be the more accurate “Starter”.
 Blighted Forgeborns have card art. Names in-client changed from Exalted to Blighted
 Added deck filter to Fuse Decks menu
 Visual representation in end-game stats when you have reached max XP on a deck
 Fixes to triggers overlapping confirm/cancel and similar choices
 Tutorial game over screen shows tutorial deck
 Campaign map control improved: Can zoom in and out with scroll wheel, map moves around more smoothly, intro shows boss
 Some awkward UI around confirm/cancels improved for Storm Caller, Hantu, and Flame Jet

General Bugfixes

 Hivemind Pact Lv. 3 Doesn’t crash multiplayer game.
 Metamind Enhancer and Metamind Synapse ability works.
 Crux cobalt determined choice shows opponent’s hand.
 Steel rosetta augment doesn’t cause error out of multiplayer game.

Set 3 Bug Fixes

 Blighted forgeborn after transform should properly match the level + exhausted state.
 Blighted Ironbeard’s Sovereign Pillars no longer gains energy counters even if there is no creature in its lane
 Elementalist Knight exalt ability works

Known Issues

 Your matchmaking elo will not update until you log out and log back in
 Cercee Soul Swap Lv 3 crashes multiplayer games
 Cypien Experimentation doesn’t work correctly
 AI using Uterra charger Lv 3 will hang game
Friend battles might take a bit to match if your elos are far apart

notes.title: Earn XP in PvP, Unlock Decks, and More Updates!
notes.content:
It is so exciting to have so many players playing SolForge Fusion! Big thanks for all your feedback—it’s been immensely helpful for our game development. For this update, we’ve smoothed out some gameplay mechanics, made the interface slicker, and squashed a few pesky bugs. Plus, we’ve cranked up the animation speed for quicker action. Exciting news: you can now snag digital deck codes in our web store. The in-app store should be ready in late May. Keep the insights coming, and enjoy the updates.

Deck and Player Experience: 

 Earn Deck XP and Player XP from PvP games. (note that you can only earn XP on Decks that are not already at Max level. Try Forging new decks if you've hit max)
 You can now earn an additional four decks on the Player XP track from our second Set, the Battle for White Fang Pass.  This now increases the total number of unlockable unique decks to 10 for all players. 


Card Functionality Improvements:

 Cards can now be clicked for play instead of requiring a drag action.
 Done work on spell cards no longer get stuck floating on the screen when played too quickly.

Hive Mechanics:

 Hive Husk and Hivemind Pact functionalities confirmed.

User Interface Enhancements:

 Player XP track automatically scrolls to your current position.
 Forgeborn abilities now display as pop-ups at the start of a new cycle.
 The Forgeborn ability panel will now dismiss automatically after use. This update addresses issues with abilities that involve dragging cards from the discard or banish pile, such as Army Commander or Dark Summoning.
 PvE cards from upgrades show before you play them.
 Cards can be magnified on the level-up screen outside of the campaign.

Animation and Speed:

 Maximum animation speed has been increased, affecting both combat speed and stat changes.

Turn Timer Adjustment:

 Turn timer reduced from 3:00 to 2:30. Further adjustments to the turn timer are planned.


SolForge Fusion Deck Store

Visit the Stone Blade Store for more decks for SolForge's first two sets: SolForge Fusion and Battle for Whitefang Pass.

The Battle for Whitefang Pass adds over 10,000 new cards, including exciting new card types like Exalts and Solbinds.

To unlock your Digital Deck, first open the SolForge Fusion App on Steam. After logging in, select the "Collection" option, then choose "Redeem Code" in the top right. Enter your code here, and your new decks will be immediately available!

Visit our Discord Announcements Channel to learn more.

Getting to Know the SolForge Fusion Website

 You can read more of the lore of SolForge Fusion in our story section. 
 You can check out every card in SolForge Fusion on our card database.
 You can find digital and live events for SolForge Fusion on our events page.

notes.title: Early Access + SolForge Fusion Roadmap
notes.content:
SolForge Fusion is now officially in Early Access. We extend our deepest gratitude to everyone playing SolForge Fusion, as well as to our Kickstarter backers and playtesters who are instrumental in getting the game where it is today.

Looking forward, we have ambitious plans from the start, and we believe outlining our immediate goals is key so you know what to expect from this game as we move from Early Access to full release. 

Most importantly, we want your feedback! Please let us know which upcoming features excite you the most. If we notice a particular feature garnering more interest, we may adjust our priorities to ensure that the fans receive the best game experience we can offer.
